findings.actual_failure: Six parametrized cases that ran and gated pull requests inside gate-main before the move (the projected-variant half of test_entry_point_imports_under_user_scope_layout, which verifies build-projected skill entry points import cleanly under user-scope layout) now silently skip on every pull request after the move — a check weakened by the move, violating the spec's Never do, its Contract ('no check is added, removed, or weakened'), and its Outcome ('Every check that gated a pull request before the move still runs'). The invocation set is preserved byte-identical, so the loss is invisible to the posture test, the parity lint, and the aggregator.
findings.observation: The sibling job runs 'python -m pytest tests/ -q' in shard-1 with no build step, and dist/ is gitignored (.gitignore:100), so its fresh checkout never has dist/apm/. tests/roster/test_credential_user_scope_invocation.py skips all six 'projected'-variant cases when dist/apm/ is absent (pytest.skip, exit 0, silent under -q). Before the move, gate-main's 'Run make build-check' (base 6dc12944e build-check.yml:231) ran before the carve-out step (base :1085), and make build-check materializes dist/apm/: Makefile:161-166 chains tools/repo/build_gate_chain.py build-check --output-dir dist, whose catalogue-build leg (build_gate_chain.py:236-238) runs 'agentbundle catalogue build --root . --output dist', and the default recipe set (packages/agentbundle/agentbundle/build/main.py:524-543) includes per-pack-apm-package (route apm, output-subdir apm). The ledger excludes dist/apm/ from the probe on the claim 'gate-main does not run make build-self, so the suite skips there today for the same reason' — false: make build-check's catalogue-build leg, not make build-self, is what supplied dist/apm/ inside gate-main.
findings.reachable_path: PR evaluates build-check.yml -> gate-catalogue-tests shard-1 -> dispatch step 'pytest tests/' -> tests/roster/test_credential_user_scope_invocation.py collected -> projected variant sees DIST_APM absent -> pytest.skip x6 -> shard exits green -> aggregator reports success. No gate reddens: the posture test pins the dispatch body's text (not skip outcomes) and the probe (build-check.yml:1664) deliberately does not check dist/apm/.
findings.rule_ref: spec ci-gate-main-carve-out-sibling Agent Rules / Never do ('Drop, skip, weaken, or narrow any check to save time') and Contract ('no check is added, removed, or weakened')

findings.actual_failure: A runner-image change that drops cat or grep from /usr/bin, /bin, or /usr/local/bin silently weakens the required gate — three promotion-drain tests skip with every check green, the exact silent-skip class the probe exists to convert into a red (the R1-001 class, different dependency). The practical trigger is improbable on today's ubuntu-latest, but the durable record compounds it: the ledger states the probe set is 'the discovered set' when its own complete static scan found more, so a future maintainer extending provisioning relies on a coverage claim the ledger itself contradicts. Repair: cover the recorded cat/grep dependencies in the probe (PINNED_PROBE_BODY and its mutations updated in the same commit per the same-commit rail), or record their exclusion in the ledger's 'Deliberately not probed' list with the reason.
findings.observation: The sibling's probe checks executables 'git sh make node' (.github/workflows/build-check.yml:1683), but the ledger's static scan records 'sh/cat/grep (promotion-drain and shell probes)' as provisioning-relevant skip sites found (verification-ledger.md:82-83) while presenting the probe set as 'the discovered set' (verification-ledger.md:85-87). The promotion-drain skip sites actually guard on 'cat' and 'grep' — tests/roster/test_promotion_drain_envelope.py:139 and :171 skip on 'cat not found in the declared tool locations' and :187 on 'grep not found' — resolved from fixed directories ('/usr/bin', '/bin', '/usr/local/bin', promotion_drain.py:185) against ALLOWLISTED_TOOLS = ('cat', 'wc', 'grep', 'ls') (promotion_drain.py:182); the probed 'sh' is not one of them. The ledger's 'Deliberately not probed' list (verification-ledger.md:88-98) covers only platform skips and dist/apm, so cat/grep appear in neither the probe set nor the not-probed list.

findings.actual_failure: Thirteen of the seventeen moved invocations — every shard-2 and shard-3 branch, including the shared-test dedup guard whose PR-red history is the recorded reason it is PR-gated — silently stop executing on every pull request. This is the exact consequence class AC-0007's cross-pin exists to prevent ('a shrunken matrix silently un-runs a branch's suites') and defeats AC-0001's invariant that every invocation runs in exactly one shard branch, reached through a dimension neither control reads. AGENTS.md's Always-do contract is that the equality pins 'redden on every workflow change, by design'; this one does not.
findings.observation: The dispatch step's `env: SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}` binding is the sole channel routing each matrix shard to its case branch, and its value is pinned by neither standing control. The posture test pins the dispatch run body verbatim (PINNED_DISPATCH_BODY, tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:505) and pins step-env KEY names only (_ALLOWED_STEP_ENV, tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:393-403, admits any SHARD value); lint-ci-parity's suite arm corroborates PR_GATED entries by step name and invocation paths (tools/lint-ci-parity.py:2952-2994) and never reads the env mapping. Verified empirically against scratch copies: mutating the workflow to `SHARD: shard-1` leaves `tools/test-build-check-workflow.py` audit() at zero violations and `tools/lint-ci-parity.py --root` exits 0; the sibling-matrix↔case cross-pin also stays satisfied because the case branches remain present and the matrix is unchanged.
findings.reachable_path: A future edit to .github/workflows/build-check.yml replaces the SHARD value with a constant or a PR-conditional expression (e.g. `SHARD: shard-1`, or `${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'shard-1' || matrix.shard }}`); every matrix shard then executes only shard-1's four invocations, each shard exits green, `needs.gate-catalogue-tests.result` is `success`, and the required aggregator `make build-check` passes — no red check anywhere.
findings.rule_ref: config-misconfig (inlined module: OWASP Top 10:2025 A02 / ASVS 5.0 V14 / Proactive Controls 2024 C5) — CI gate-config integrity: the sibling's matrix→shell dispatch channel is unpinned by both standing controls

findings.actual_failure: The fail-closed guard AC-0008 exists to convert provisioning gaps into reds is silently removed: a dependency whose absence manifests as a pytest skip — tomlkit (31 importorskip sites across the moved trees), jsonschema, yaml, node, or the dist/apm/ projected-variant cases (the R1-001 class) — reverts to a green run with silently skipped cases. This is the exact defeat the `exit 0`-prefixed-body mutation family was written to catch, in a form the mutation matrix does not enumerate, and it also violates the spec's Never-do 'Add a step-level `if:` to the sibling's steps' with nothing machine-checking it. AC-0008's letter ('The sibling probes its provisioning before any suite runs') is false in the mutated state while its verification mechanism stays green.
findings.observation: The probe step's conditionality is unpinned by both standing controls. The posture test exempts the sibling's provisioning steps from the phase/condition audit (_PROVISIONING_NOT_AUDITED, tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:204-208) and pins only the probe's run body by equality (sibling-probe-body-exact, tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:1636-1640); its mutation family covers step removal, body-emptying, dependency-dropping, reordering, and the dist-check (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:2788-2813) but not a step-level `if:`. lint-ci-parity dispositions the probe as PROVISIONING (tools/lint-ci-parity.py:644-648), and `_derived_step_condition` returns None for non-CHECK steps, so the suite arm's condition audit never reaches it. Verified empirically against scratch copies: adding `if: ${{ false }}` to the probe step leaves `tools/test-build-check-workflow.py` audit() at zero violations and `tools/lint-ci-parity.py --root` exits 0.
findings.reachable_path: A future edit to .github/workflows/build-check.yml adds a step-level `if:` to `Probe provisioning (gate-catalogue-tests, fail closed, not skip)` (.github/workflows/build-check.yml:1669) — any falsy expression, a PR-scoped predicate, or a per-shard predicate that skips some shards; Actions marks the step skipped, a skipped step does not fail the job, the shard exits green, and the aggregator's `!= "success"` guard passes.
findings.rule_ref: config-misconfig (inlined module: OWASP Top 10:2025 A02 / ASVS 5.0 V14 / Proactive Controls 2024 C5) — CI gate-config integrity: the fail-closed provisioning probe is not pinned against conditional skip

findings.actual_failure: Live maintainer procedure now attributes a load-bearing verification to a job/step that no longer exists, misdirecting failure attribution for release-pin misses and leaving documented guidance contradicting the shipped workflow — the same doc-drift class the round-1 R1-003 sweep repaired inside the workflows, surviving here because the sweep was scoped to .github/workflows/ and docs/architecture/verification-graph.md. The gating behaviour itself is intact (the sibling feeds the required aggregator), so no bug ships; the cost is diagnostic misdirection and a stale claim that will compound as readers trust it.
findings.observation: docs/guides/how-to/cut-a-package-release.md:102 still tells a maintainer that the agentbundle version-pin roster test 'runs on every PR through the build-check gate-main job, whose `python -m pytest tests/ -q` step collects every roster module'. This diff removed that step from gate-main and moved the invocation verbatim to the gate-catalogue-tests sibling's shard-1 (enforced by the posture test's `moved-steps-left-gate-main` check at tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:1679); gate-main no longer carries any `pytest tests/ -q` step.
findings.reachable_path: A maintainer cutting an agentbundle release reads the guide's 'Files that move together' section to learn where the six-file version pin is enforced; on a red PR from a forgotten pin, they open gate-main's log to find the failing roster module, but the collecting invocation now runs in the gate-catalogue-tests sibling's shard-1 (build-check.yml:1701), so the named job and step are absent from the log they inspect.
findings.rule_ref: quality-engineer maintainability — naming-and-docs that lie: doc-code drift introduced by the change (stale attribution of a moved step); the change's own T3/T5 comment-sweep bar ('no comment still asserting the carve-out or dedup guard runs in gate-main') applied only to .github/workflows/

findings.actual_failure: A one-line future edit adding `working-directory:` to the dispatch step changes what all 17 pinned invocations resolve against — `pytest tests/ -q` collects a different tree, `--root .` and the probe's `test -d dist/apm` resolve against a different root — while every posture check stays green and the same-commit pin-update rail is never triggered (no pinned text changes). The posture test's own ladder table (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:75) records `working-directory: tools` as a measured bypass for pinned statements, which is why the anchor and four gate-main roster steps carry this pin; the sibling's dispatch step holds the entire moved invocation set and carries none.
findings.observation: The delivery pins the sibling's three load-bearing step bodies by equality — `PINNED_DISPATCH_BODY` (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:505), `PINNED_MATERIALIZE_BODY` (:545), `PINNED_PROBE_BODY` (:558) — and every pinned statement is a repo-relative path (`python -m pytest tests/ -q`, `--root .`, `--output dist`, `test -d dist/apm`). But none of the three steps (`Materialize catalogue projections (gate-catalogue-tests)` .github/workflows/build-check.yml:1659, `Probe provisioning (gate-catalogue-tests, fail closed, not skip)` :1669, `dispatch catalogue-test shard` :1688) appears in `_NO_CWD_STEPS` (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:575), whose `no-working-directory[...]` check (:1521) is the file's only cwd control and fires only for the nine enumerated gate-main/gate-sast/gate-export-boundary pairs. The round-2 repairs closed the env-value and step-`if:` dimensions on exactly these three steps (SEC-R3-001, SEC-R3-002) and left the cwd dimension unpinned; no mutation covers it.
findings.reachable_path: Reproduced against the shipped workflow: inserting `working-directory: tools` above the dispatch step's `env:` block (build-check.yml:1693-1694) and re-running the posture test's `audit()` returns ZERO violations; likewise `working-directory: packages/agentbundle` on the probe step returns zero violations. Control mutation in the same run: `SHARD: shard-1` (constant) reddens `sibling-dispatch-env-value-exact`, proving the harness bites and the cwd mutations are genuinely invisible to every check (`sibling-dispatch-body-exact`, `sibling-dispatch-env-value-exact`, `sibling-no-step-if`, `step-env-keys-allowlisted[gate-catalogue-tests]`, and lint-ci-parity's path corroboration all compare text, not resolution root).
findings.rule_ref: ci-gate-main-carve-out-sibling AC-0001 (dispatch-body equality pin as the standing control for the moved invocation set) and AC-0008 (probe/materialize pinned by equality with mutation-proven efficacy); the posture test's own working-directory control discipline (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py `_NO_CWD_STEPS`, whose rationale records a redirected cwd as a measured bypass for pinned statements)

findings.actual_failure: The required pull-request gate silently stops running 7 of the 17 moved invocations (including the entire 27-file tools group) with every posture and parity check green — exactly the 'a shrunken matrix silently un-runs a branch's suites' failure AC-0007's both-direction cross-pin exists to catch, reached through a matrix key the reader does not model.
findings.observation: The gate-catalogue-tests matrix mapping is pinned only through its flow-style `shard:` list: `_matrix_shards` (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:795-807) reads nothing else under `matrix:`, and `tools/lint-ci-parity.py` does not read the matrix at all. Mutation-verified at HEAD: adding `exclude:\n  - shard: shard-2` under `matrix:` (.github/workflows/build-check.yml:1638-1639) leaves `python3 tools/test-build-check-workflow.py` fully green (the declared shard list still satisfies `sibling-matrix-shards`, `sibling-matrix-covers-case-branches`, and `sibling-case-branches-cover-matrix`) and `python3 tools/lint-ci-parity.py` green (exit 0, 258 targets corroborated). The round-2 repairs (`sibling-dispatch-env-value-exact`, `sibling-no-step-if`) hold and are not implicated; this is the next unpinned layer their pin family leaves free, in the posture test's own ladder sense.
findings.reachable_path: A one-line PR edit to .github/workflows/build-check.yml:1638-1639 adding an `exclude:` entry (a documented, legitimate Actions feature, so actionlint and zizmor in ci-security.yml do not flag it) drops that matrix replica: shard-2's seven invocations — packs/architect pack + architect-assess + architect-design, packs/core pack + workspace-status, packs/credential-brokers pack, and the 27-file tools pytest group, 7 of the 17 moved invocations — run in zero replicas. The surviving shards pass, `needs.gate-catalogue-tests.result` is `success`, and the required aggregator check `make build-check` reports green.
findings.rule_ref: config-misconfig — CI workflow checklist item 7 (matrix dimensions cannot collapse a gate into a no-op: a matrix value that routes every replica to the same branch, or to none); CWE-16 Configuration; ASVS 5.0 V14.4.1

findings.actual_failure: The provisioning channel feeding the moved gate can be silently extended with network-fetched unreviewed content or re-pointed to a different dependency set, defeating the fail-closed provisioning posture AC-0008's probe exists to guarantee — it verifies availability, not provenance — and leaving the supply-chain pin family that holds the materialize and probe bodies stopped one step short of the install body.
findings.observation: The sibling's `Install Python dependencies (gate-catalogue-tests)` step (.github/workflows/build-check.yml:1654-1658) is the one provisioning step of the new job whose run body is pinned nowhere: the posture test lists it in `_PROVISIONING_NOT_AUDITED` (tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:203-208, exempting it from the gate-main phase audit, which does not apply to the sibling anyway) and defines no PINNED_* body for it, unlike the materialize step (PINNED_MATERIALIZE_BODY, tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:545) and the probe (PINNED_PROBE_BODY, tools/test-build-check-workflow.py:558). Mutation-verified at HEAD: prepending a `curl -fsSL https://…/install.sh | sh` line to the install body, and re-pointing `-r tools/requirements.txt` to a different requirements file, each leave both the posture test and lint-ci-parity green (lint exit 0 on the curl mutation).
findings.reachable_path: A one-line edit to the install step's run body (.github/workflows/build-check.yml:1655-1658) — an added fetch, an added package, or a re-pointed requirements source — reaches the provisioning channel of the required gate with no check reddening: the probe that AC-0008 pins asserts only availability of the four discovered modules, so added content, or a re-pointed source that still provides them, passes it and the suites run against a dependency set nothing pinned. Removal-direction drift fails closed at runtime via the probe/materialize steps; the addition and re-point directions are silent.
findings.rule_ref: supply-chain — CI checklist item 3 (provisioning steps materialize/install cannot be silently skipped or re-pointed; their body is pinned) and item 4 (no new network fetch of unreviewed content during the moved steps); CWE-16 Configuration
